wrong_claims: Section 6: 'Users with View All Data or Modify All Data (for example System Administrator) can still see it.' View All Data and Modify All Data do not override field-level security. With no FLS grant, no user, including admins, can see Unique_Review_Key__c in the UI or API.

defects.defect: Wrong security claim: says VAD/MAD users can see a field that has no FLS grant.
defects.skill_gap: The SKILL.md org-verification note says View All Data users see fields without FLS grants. It is wrong and caused this.

defects.defect: The question bundled 'confirm block with an error vs a warning'. The requirement ('can only leave one') already implies blocking, so this implementation choice had a clear default. The missing-value exemption part was a reasonable intent question because it decides whether agent-created reviews are covered.
defects.skill_gap: SKILL.md step 5's 'predict the answer first' guidance exists but does not stop sub-questions whose answer the requirement already gives from riding along in a legitimate question.

defects.defect: Reviews created through AgentReviewActions never set Order_Date__c, so the only code channel is exempt from the rule. This is disclosed as an open item, but it partly defeats the requirement for that channel.
defects.skill_gap: None; handled as a disclosed open decision.
